note: Self-learning layout archetype library (Stage 10). Each archetype has a SIGNATURE the matcher scores a measured layout against. On a confirmed analysis, recordConfirmation() appends an exemplar and re-centers the numeric ranges, so thresholds self-calibrate. Novel layouts (best matchScore < noveltyThreshold) are flagged for human confirmation per the user's 'human-confirm novel patterns' decision.

archetypes.name: Top/bottom split — A-roll bottom, B-roll top
archetypes.description: Talking head fills the lower region; B-roll (often a ~1:1 square) sits on top. The reference reel's style.
archetypes.whenToUse: Educational/promo reels where the speaker narrates over illustrative B-roll stacked above them.

archetypes.name: Top/bottom split — A-roll top, B-roll bottom
archetypes.description: Talking head fills the upper region; B-roll fills the lower region.
archetypes.whenToUse: Reaction/commentary reels where the speaker is up top and reacts to content below.

archetypes.name: Circular PIP talking head over fullscreen B-roll
archetypes.description: Speaker's face in a small circular picture-in-picture, usually a corner, over fullscreen B-roll/screen-recording. NOTE: layout_analyzer.py does NOT yet detect circular PIP (no HoughCircles); such references are handled by cv-correction.ts / pip-locator.ts and would be measured as 'fullscreen' here. Kept for the broader system + a future circle-detection stage.
archetypes.whenToUse: Screen-recording explainers / app walkthroughs with a small face bubble.

archetypes.name: Fullscreen talking head with captions
archetypes.description: Speaker fills the whole 9:16 frame; captions overlaid, no persistent B-roll region.

archetypes.name: B-roll only (no persistent talking head)
archetypes.description: Montage of B-roll with voiceover; no on-screen speaker region. Distinguished from fullscreen_aroll by the ABSENCE of a persistent face (the CV core emits type 'broll_only' vs 'fullscreen').
archetypes.whenToUse: VO-driven montages, product reels, b-roll-only ads.

archetypes.name: Multi-region vertical stack (3-5 bands)
archetypes.description: Stacked composite: header/title bar + one or more content windows (B-roll, screen-recording strip) + talking head at the bottom. Decoded by the unified path (VLM bands + CV seam-snap); the 2-region CV core misreads it as fullscreen.
archetypes.whenToUse: Grok-style explainer stacks: title + content window(s) + A-roll band.

archetypes.name: PIP talking head over fullscreen background
archetypes.description: Persistent non-full-width (often rounded-rect) A-roll panel floating over a full-frame background whose content class changes over time (B-roll / diagram / screen recording). Decoded by the unified path; the 2-region CV core misreads it as split/fullscreen.
archetypes.whenToUse: Screen-recording / diagram explainers with a persistent speaker bubble.
